news.headline: Crude Surges to $102.79/bbl on Saudi Pipeline Shutdown & Iran-US Tensions
news.what_happened: Saudi Arabia shut its East-West crude pipeline after geopolitical attacks linked to Iran-backed groups. US-Iran conflict over the Strait of Hormuz drove WTI to $102.79 (+2.74%) and Brent to ~$104/bbl. Iranian state media reported Oman talks with Gulf states, offering partial de-escalation hope.
news.why_it_matters: India imports ~85% of crude. At $104/bbl CAD widens, rupee weakens further, and inflation risk resurges — delaying RBI rate cuts. Upstream oil companies benefit directly; airlines, paints, and tyres face cost pressure.

news.headline: US Markets Rebound — S&P 500 +0.86%, Nasdaq +0.96% on Friday Sep 11
news.what_happened: After a 4-session decline, US stocks rallied strongly as CPI inflation matched expectations and oil briefly pulled back. Dow rose 509 pts (+0.98%) to 52,573; S&P 500 +0.86% to 7,656.98; Nasdaq +0.96% to 26,333.
news.why_it_matters: A positive US close is a bullish global risk-on cue. GIFT Nifty at +0.51% signals a gap-up open for Tuesday. IT stocks get a direct Nasdaq tailwind; large-cap FII-held stocks may see buying.

news.headline: Rupee at ₹95.64/USD — Near Historic Low on Crude-Driven CAD Pressure
news.what_happened: The Indian rupee has weakened to ₹95.64/USD, driven by elevated crude oil prices, geopolitical risk-off flows, and FII selling. This represents significant depreciation from the ₹83-84 levels prior to the current geopolitical cycle.
news.why_it_matters: Massive structural tailwind for IT exporters (TCS, INFY — ~90-98% USD revenues) and pharma exporters. Rupee at 95.64 is not yet fully reflected in consensus earnings estimates — upside surprise risk on quarterly results. Bearish for airlines with USD-denominated fuel and lease costs.

news.headline: Nikkei -1.93% Today — Asia Risk-Off on Energy Costs & Rate Hike Fears
news.what_happened: Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 1.93% to 64,011 on Monday, led by tech stocks (SoftBank -12%, Kioxia -8.6%). Surging energy prices are fueling expectations of rate hikes from both the US Fed and Bank of Japan.
news.why_it_matters: Partial risk-off signal from Asia. GIFT Nifty is still +0.51%, suggesting India may outperform. However, if Asian selling deepens, FII flows into India could remain muted on Tuesday.

news.headline: RBI Rejects Tata Sons Exemption from CIF Category
news.what_happened: RBI on September 11 rejected Tata Sons' application for exemption from the Core Investment Company (CIF) rules, making a public listing mandatory amid leadership turbulence at the group.
news.why_it_matters: Tata Sons must now proceed with an IPO. Short-term uncertainty for Tata group stocks; medium-term IPO could unlock significant value. Watch for clarification from Tata Sons on listing timeline.

picks.catalyst: Crude oil at $102.79/bbl (+2.74%) — Saudi pipeline shutdown, Iran-US geopolitical supply disruption

Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown removes a key alternate supply route — prices likely to stay elevated. Stock at ₹237 is 23% below 52-week high of ₹307.50, offering meaningful re-rating room.
